233 The Green
Wolverhampton, WV9 5JF

Hospital number: 77455394
DOB: 11.08.1957
NHS No: 7349208103
Referrer: Dr Simon Lloyd

Dear Dr Polishchuk,

Your appointment on 20 June 2026 cannot go ahead. We apologise for this. A new appointment has been made for Wednesday 8 July 2026 at 1.40pm.

We apologise for the disruption to your plans.

We are a teaching hospital and students may be present. You can ask for them not to be.

If you feel unwell before your appointment, speak to your GP. If your condition gets worse before your appointment, contact your GP or call NHS 111.

Please bring this letter and your glasses or hearing aids if you use them. Please bring a list of your current medicines.

Children should not be brought to the clinic unless they are the patient. You may bring a relative or friend with you.

Yours faithfully,
Cardiology Administration Team
